posts.name: The Burning Stickman
posts.cooked:
An idea that struck me that would work for the RPG.

Aleksandr Tsarev was not the only Soviet soldier exposed to an OblivAeon shard. Also among the volunteers was a diehard Communist devotee. The shard's effect on him was subtler than it was on Tsarev, giving him incredible eyesight and impeccable aim, and his zeal for the Communist cause only grew.

His codename: The Marxman

posts.name: Cult of Gloom
posts.cooked:
Are we having a Communist themed super hero naming party?

Individual with the ability to slow down time for other people- Stallin

Individual with the ability to spin really quickly, creating whirlwhinds and crashing into enemies- Revoultionary

 

Some names for alternate, Soviet versions of heroes and villians.

Unity = Means of Prodcution

Captain Cosmic = Captain Cosmonaut

Infinator = Manifesto

Absoulte Zero = Grandfather Winter

Biomancer = Five Year Planner, really more of a nickname for him always having everything thought out in advance to make things go "just as planned"

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
Oh, man, I really hope we get a full explanation of that page someday.  Looks like there's some sort of Soviet category or mastermind that will show up in the same context as Ermine and Fright Train.  What's coming to my mind is a situation like the Linear Guild from Order of the Stick, which has some staple members but others get replaced as they quit or die.  So the Vengeful Five originally included Proletariat, but when he quits, he's replaced by other ex-Soviets.

I'm also excited that we might see Iron Curtain in the RPG someday.  We know virtually nothing about him.
